3751 osphus {os-foos'}

找不到與其意義相近的字; TDNT - 5:496,736; 陰性名詞

AV - loins 8; 8

1) 腰部
2) 生殖器所在之處
 #徒 2:30|"他的後裔"原文是"他的腰所結的果實"
 #來 7:5,10|"從身中生的"原文是"出自...的腰"
record.edic_text:
3751 osphus {os-foos'}

of uncertain affinity; TDNT - 5:496,736; n f

AV - loins 8; 8

1) the hip (loin)
   1a) to gird, gird about, the loins
2) a loin, the (two) loins
   2a) the place where the Hebrews thought the generative power
       (semen) resided
